title: Theologia Germanica
author: Anonymous (Winkworth trans)
description: An anonymous medieval Christian work on self-will, surrender and the life of God within the soul. It explores the transformation of conduct and understanding through detachment from the isolated self.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (EPUB from PDF). Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/theologiagermani00winkuoft).
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
